name: How long does a typical painting project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical painting project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a painting project depends on several factors, including the size of the area, the complexity of the work, the type of paint and finish chosen, and current weather conditions for exterior jobs. A small room might take a day or two, while an entire house could take a week or more. We provide a detailed timeline after assessing your specific project during the initial consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration varies based on size, complexity, and materials; a detailed timeline is provided after assessment.
